physical_origin: spots, faculae, granulation, oscillations, magnetic cycles
why_it_matters: apparent line-profile shifts can exceed an Earth analogue signal
representative_mitigation: multi-line indicators, cadence design, photometry, Gaussian-process or physical models
residual_problem: activity is wavelength-, line-, and timescale-dependent and is not an instrumental calibration term

physical_origin: finite photons and incomplete line information
why_it_matters: sets a target-, exposure-, and wavelength-dependent floor
representative_mitigation: high throughput, broad spectral grasp, exposure-time control
residual_problem: headline instrument precision cannot be transferred between stars

physical_origin: reference drift, line density, detector mapping
why_it_matters: cm/s work requires a stable wavelength solution across years
representative_mitigation: laser frequency combs, stabilized etalons, hollow-cathode lamps
residual_problem: calibrator stability does not remove illumination or stellar errors

physical_origin: variable near/far-field fibre illumination and coherent speckle
why_it_matters: moves or reshapes the spectrograph line-spread function
representative_mitigation: octagonal fibres, double scramblers, agitation, tip-tilt guiding
residual_problem: some illumination errors are not tracked by simultaneous calibration

physical_origin: temperature, pressure, stress, and detector-temperature changes
why_it_matters: changes optical geometry and pixel mapping
representative_mitigation: vacuum vessels, nested thermal control, low-expansion materials
residual_problem: maintenance and thermal excursions create offsets and era boundaries

physical_origin: pixel non-uniformity, charge transfer inefficiency, persistence, read noise
why_it_matters: distorts extracted line positions and shapes
residual_problem: detector behaviour evolves and differs between CCD and infrared arrays

physical_origin: Earth atmospheric molecular absorption and emission
why_it_matters: contaminates stellar lines, especially in the NIR
representative_mitigation: masking, forward modelling, simultaneous atmospheric constraints
residual_problem: time-variable line shapes and winds limit correction fidelity

physical_origin: observer motion, exposure-weighted photon arrival time, chromatic extinction
why_it_matters: timing and chromatic weighting errors map directly into RV
representative_mitigation: chromatic exposure meters and relativistic barycentric algorithms
residual_problem: weather and guiding make the effective midpoint wavelength-dependent

physical_origin: pipeline versions, masks, templates, quality cuts
why_it_matters: algorithm changes can create offsets or alter uncertainty estimates
representative_mitigation: versioned reductions, open products, run manifests
residual_problem: published values are not automatically comparable across pipelines
